jobs.description:
You will join an international consulting firm based in the center of Brussels. The office is easily accessible by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

As an Office Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Welcome visitors professionally and direct them to the right contact or meeting area.
• Manage incoming calls and route messages accurately to support clear communication.
• Handle incoming and outgoing post, parcels and deliveries in an organised way.
• Keep the reception area tidy, presentable and ready for daily visitors.
• Coordinate meeting room bookings and help ensure rooms are prepared for use.
• Provide day-to-day administrative support.
• Order office supplies. 
• Respond to general enquiries and provide practical information to visitors and colleagues.

• You are perfectly bilingual in French and English, Dutch is a plus. 
• You have a first experience in receptionist, office management or administration. 
• Ability to manage a reception desk and greet visitors in a professional manner.
• Good organisational skills and proactive.
• Excellent communication skills.
• Good skills in MS Office.

This position is within the property industry and based near Ternat.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting to the Accounting Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and project-related costs.
• Managing and overseeing the invoice and purchase order cycle.
• Reviewing accounting entries, allocations, and VAT-related controls.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
• Performing variance analysis and preparing financial reporting for key stakeholders.
• Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and audit processes.
• Ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal control procedures.
• Contributing to process improvements, financial systems enhancements, and European-wide projects.
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive transparency, efficiency, and cost optimisation.
• Supporting knowledge-sharing and collaboration within the finance team.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 4-5 years of experience in accounting or financial reporting.
• Previous experience within a services, retail, or similar operational environment.
• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.
• Experience with SAP; S4Hana knowledge is considered a strong asset.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Good knowledge of IFRS and/or local GAAP standards is an advantage.
• Fluent English communication skills; additional European languages are a plus.
• Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Comfortable working in an international and fast-paced environment

An organisation operating in the public sector.

Jobomschrijving

As an Accountant AZ your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and public sector regulations.
• Manage accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.
• Coordinate with external auditors and provide necessary documentation.

A successful Bilingual Accountant should have:

• Strong knowledge of Winbooks.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Strong knowledge of public sector financial regulations.
• Residence in Brussels.

• Experience at least 1 year in accounting.
• Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.

jobs.occupation: Head of Sales - Regulated B2B Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international service provider operating across multiple countries in Europe and beyond. With several hundred employees in Belgium and a strong position in its market, the company is currently entering a new phase of growth driven by innovation, strategic partnerships and evolving customer needs.To support this development, our client is looking for a Head of Sales Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the Managing Director and sitting on the local leadership team, you will lead the commercial function, shape the sales strategy, develop key customer relationships and manage a team of experienced sales professionals.Commercial Strategy & Growth

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Translate business objectives into clear action plans and measurable KPIs.
• Identify growth opportunities and drive business development initiatives.
• Monitor commercial performance, sales activity and pipeline development.
• Contribute to the overall business strategy as a member of the management team.
Team Leadership

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 3 sales professionals.
• Foster a high-performance culture focused on customer value and commercial results.
• Support the team in managing complex sales cycles and strategic accounts.
• Ensure effective collaboration across departments.
Key Account Management

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with major national customers.
• Manage executive-level conversations with key decision-makers.
• Lead commercial negotiations and contract discussions.
• Act as a trusted partner for strategic clients and stakeholders.
Marketing Coordination

• Coordinate local marketing initiatives in collaboration with international colleagues.
• Manage relationships with external marketing partners and agencies.
• Support brand visibility, customer engagement and commercial campaigns.
• Contribute to market positioning and business growth initiatives.

What matters most is your ability to lead teams, build commercial strategies and drive business results in a B2B environment.You bring:

• A proven track record in a B2B commercial leadership role.
• Experience managing and developing sales teams.
• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking skills.
• Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Experience working with large accounts and complex customer environments.
• The ability to build structure, set priorities and drive execution.
• A hands-on mindset combined with strong leadership qualities.
• Curiosity and the willingness to learn and understand a new industry.
• Fluency in Dutch, French, English

The Account Manager is responsible for building and maintaining strong, long-term client relationships while actively driving business growth. Beyond managing existing accounts, the role places a strong emphasis on proactive client development, including prospection within the existing portfolio, cross-selling, and identifying new revenue opportunities. The Account Manager acts as both a trusted advisor and a commercial driver, combining relationship management with strong sales, negotiation, and business development skills.
 

 
• Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with assigned clients.
 
• Ensure timely and successful delivery of solutions according to client needs and objectives, and this is within the existing HighCo DATA services package.
 
• Conduct regular business reviews with clients to assess performance and identify opportunities. 

 
• Strong sales and negotiation skills
 
• Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities in French, Dutch and English
 
• Customer-centric mindset with strong business acumen
 
• Ability to identify and convert opportunities into revenue
 
• Proactive and results-oriented approach
 
• Strong organizational and time management skills
 
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
 
• Team collaboration and cross-functional coordination
 
• Highly driven with a strong commercial mindset
 
• Results-oriented with a focus on growth and performance

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Wielsbeke site, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician in 2 shifts. As a preventive maintenance technician, you are passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment.

• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success

• You are willing to work in a 2-shift regime

Mechnical Design Engineer (R&D Professional) 
 

Company
 

Xeikon is a world-leading innovator in digital printing, focusing on labels and packaging, commercial print, and related applications. Operating in an industrial capital goods environment, Xeikon designs, develops, manufactures and markets high-quality digital colour printers and presses.
 

Xeikon is part of Flint Group. Its pioneering products and services form the foundation of Flint Group Digital Printing Solutions. This division broadens Flint Group’s portfolio of conventional and digital printing solutions, offering a unique combination of equipment, consumables and services to customers worldwide.
 

 
 

Mission
 

As a member of the 
R&D Electromechanical Design team, you will contribute directly to the development of next-generation digital printing engines. You will take responsibility for mechanical designs that translate innovative ideas into reliable, industrial-grade products.
 

 
 

Main Responsibilities (see attachement for all details)

Profile
 

· You hold a 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in (electro)mechanical engineering or industrial design.
 

· You have 
3–5 years of experience in mechanical design within an industrial or high-tech environment.
 

· You have solid knowledge of 
manufacturing techniques, such as machining, sheet metal, injection moulding, extrusion and 3D printing, including their capabilities and limitations.
 

· You have experience with 
3D CAD software, preferably 
PTC Creo.
 

· You have a strong understanding of 
mechanical physics.
 

· You are a 
hands-on team player with good communication skills in 
Dutch and English.
 

· You are analytical, solution-oriented and able to work independently.
 

· You are eager to learn, resilient under pressure and motivated by technical challenges.

R&D Project Manager Inkjet
 

Flint Group Digital Xeikon 
 | 
 Lier, Belgium 
 | 
 Full-time
 

Lead industrial inkjet development from business case to market introduction, bringing multidisciplinary teams together to turn customer needs into production-ready printing solutions.
 

About Flint Group Digital Xeikon and the role
 

Flint Group Digital Xeikon, part of Flint Group, develops digital printing solutions for labels and packaging. As R&D Project Manager, you will lead projects across our inkjet portfolio, including Panther UV inkjet label presses and IDERA aqueous inkjet solutions for corrugated applications.
 

Reporting to the Director Inkjet & Program Management, you will guide development, validation, industrialisation and launch, leading cross-functional teams through collaboration and influence.
 

What you will do
 

--> see attachement
 

What you bring
 

• 
 A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, applied science or technology, or equivalent relevant experience.
 

• 
 At least five years of project management experience in complex industrial product development, including work with external suppliers or development partners.
 

• 
 Strong planning, budget and risk management skills, with experience of validation, industrialisation and structured project reviews.
 

• 
 The technical judgement to work across disciplines, communicate clearly and align stakeholders without formal authority.
 

• 
 Professional proficiency in English and willingness to travel internationally when projects require it. Dutch or other languages are an advantage.
 

Industrial inkjet, digital printing, capital equipment or hardware/software development experience is an advantage. Project management certification is welcome but not essential.
 

Why join us
 

Own technically challenging projects with a direct impact on Flint Group Digital Xeikon’s global inkjet portfolio. Collaborate with engineering specialists and international partners, and help improve how we develop and deliver products. Hybrid working is available in line with company policy. We offer a salary package with fringe benefits in line with the market.
 

Interested
 

Apply with your CV and a short introduction highlighting your experience in industrial product development and project delivery.
